mapper.select: SELECT c.pc_num AS pcNum, c.post_num AS postNum, c.user_num AS userNum, c.pc_content AS pcContent, c.parent_pc_num AS parentPcNum, c.pc_created_at AS pcCreatedAt, /* 존재하지 않는 pc_updated_at, pc_is_deleted 컬럼은 제거했습니다 */ u.user_name AS userName, u.user_id AS userId FROM post_comment c JOIN user u ON c.user_num = u.user_num WHERE c.post_num = #{postNum} /* 정렬 로직 유지 */ ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_pc_num, c.pc_num) ASC, c.pc_created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment (post_num, user_num, pc_content, parent_pc_num) VALUES (#{postNum}, #{userNum}, #{pcContent}, #{parentPcNum})
